nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Mild-Up UVLOCK SPF 50

avis.texte: I thought this was a good sunscreen because of the reviews but….as a poc i wouldn't wear this.

I absolutely loved this sunscreen. I had heard about it before, but I never imagined it would be this good. From the very first day I tried it, I haven't stopped using it, and my skin is definitely grateful for it. I also love the finish and the texture, and I have to say it leaves very little white cast.
This sunscreen has been my go-to for the last year. It has helped protect my skin without leaving that white sheen on my skin. I put it on every day before using makeup. It's wonderful!
Best sunscreen and because it also tones, allows me to avoid an extra step during my mornings. Its sufficient for me to not have to use another tone up cream product.

I have really sensitive, eczema-prone skin, and most sunscreens are an immediate no for me. This one has been an absolute dream! It does have a white cast, but it blends pretty well for me (I'm really pale though, so I can't speak for how strong the white cast would be on other people). It also sits well under my makeup. It has a very light texture that you can feel on top of the skin, but it's not greasy and doesn't pill. I've used it on my face, neck, and shoulders with no problems. It hasn't left any residue on my clothing either.
One of the best sunscreens I have used. It does not sting my eyes at all, which is my favorite part of this sunscreen!

avis.titre: has a decent amount of wh
avis.texte: has a decent amount of white cast but is not greasy and does not pill under makeup

I really enjoyed the Birch Mild-Up Sunscreen UVLock SPF 50+ Broad Spectrum — it feels lightweight on the skin, blends in easily without a heavy white cast, and provides great protection. It keeps my skin comfortable and slightly brightened throughout the day.

As someone who has tried over 10 mineral sunscreens, this one stands out as the best. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or clog my pores, which is a huge win for me. I have fairly pale skin, so the white cast that others mention actually works in my favor. It blends in nicely and almost acts like a lightweight foundation. My skin genuinely looks its best when I use this product.
love it but it stains eyes too much. im in tears trying to find a korean sunscreen that will not stain my eyes, desperately. **sigh**?

I don't have dry skin but this totally dried me out, accentuating fine lines. And it has terrible whitecast that didn't dissipate, even though I am pale. It might suit an acne-prone teenager who is extremely fair. I can't use it on my face anymore, as it makes me look grotesque. I will use it on my décolletage and hands instead.
if your someone with medium tan skin or darker, this leave a white cast!

avis.titre: Wish it didnt have a white cast to the skin
avis.texte: I would love this product more is it didn't feel like super thick and had that white cast to the skin. I know its sunscreen but there are a a lot of of Korean sunscreens that apply like lotion which I love. It does its job and protects my skin but I dont love the application. I may not buy this product again
It feels nice on the skin, has matte to natural finish. However, it leaves a white cast.

avis.titre: mild feeling given improvement on my skin but has whitecast
avis.texte: It has a mild weight feeling for a 50 spf, it does not feel heavy and has cooled down my acne scars that I have had for years. The only downside, it does have a white cast and there is a smell of sunscreen that lingers.

I have oily acne prone skin and found that zinc sunscreens work best for me. Yes this has a slight white cast when first applied, but it blends in once you really apply it. I've never had issues with my skin keeping the white cast. I love the low scent profile it has and does not irritate my skin. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated without the heavy feeling of sunscreen. I highly recommend!
Love it great delivery always fast i lobe the product and would recommend it.
Didnt overwhelm my skin or feel heavy thru out the day. My skin is patchy tho and i didn't moisturize before putting on sunscreen because i didnt want to feel heavy.
Didnt overwhelm my skin or feel heavy thru out the day. My skin is patchy tho and i didn't moisturize before putting on sunscreen because i didnt want to feel heavy.

My skin doesn't tolerate chemical sunscreens, so I'm always on the lookout for mineral SPF. This Round Lab mineral sunscreen is the best I've ever used. It's soothing and moisturizing with a matte finish that is perfect for sensitive, oily, acne-prone skin.
I used this before it's good it runs out pretty quickly I don't like the packaging.
I need to avoid chemical sunscreens, so I've tried every mineral formula I can find. This one is the best! Creamy and nourishing while feeling airy and lightweight. Thank you, Round Lab!

I needed a new mineral sunscreen and I knew Round Lab would deliver. I checked the ingredients and it's on par for what I was looking for. I already use the soothing gel religiously, so it made sense to add this into my routine.

I finally found a sunscreen that doesn't make me wanna tear my skin off because it's so itchy afterwards. This sunscreen does not contain titanium dioxide and that is a contributing factor to a skin reaction that I've previously had with other brands . I will only buy this sunscreen, moving forward.

avis.titre: safe to use around eyes , non burning
avis.texte: I really enjoyed the formula that is thin & easy to blend, it won't peel but it does leave a white cast
I love this sunscreen! Mild smell, no whitecast, not sticky, absorbs quickly. It's like I'm not even wearing sunscreen. (But i am!)

I enjoyed this product and will stick to it. I've tried a variety of sunscreens for my face throughout the years which all ended up causing some sort of irritation. I heard about this sunscreen through the Yuka app. The Birch Mild Sunscreen did not irritate my face at all whatsoever. I enjoyed how light it was and left my face feeling moisturized. In addition it is pretty easy to spread around the face without leaving too much of a white cast. I'd definitely would recommended it !
i can use it for my children too as it is light and moisture. kids like it as it is not sticky and does not leave any white marks. this is our family's GO TO favorite sunscreen
I was worried about this being a tone up because I had no idea what to expect but this has by far become my favorite sunscreen.
I really like it for how well it works. My only issue is im tan and this leaves a white cast on my face
I love this sunscreen! It worked well with my sensitive skin and offered solid sun protection throughout the day.

I bought this because its mineral which means better for my body and the environment. However, it left the most horrible white cast that I can't use it anywhere but the pool. Mind you, I am a translucent ginger, so I'm already as white as can be, and it left a white cast on me. At least ow I know how I'll look as a ghost.
Goes on smooth, matte, and with minimal white cast. Doesn't pill with any of my skincare. I'm extremely acne prone and this doesn't cause breakouts!

I give this 5 stars for being a US mineral sunscreen. Yes, it's not the same as the Korean version. However, this is better than other US mineral sunscreens. It's working for me and I will continuously buy it.

This is sadly not the same as the version purchased in South Korea. It is thick and leaves the skin slightly sticky and tacky. It goes on with a very strong white cast that takes forever to blend in. On the plus side, it does protect well from sun exposure. But with other options that work as well, I won't repurchase this one.

I bought this thinking I'd hate it and just throw it away. I usually dislike mineral sunscreens but because I have rosacea, my derm really wanted me to switch to mineral. I used this and I loved it so much. I didn't personally see a white cast but I did rub it in well. There's no smell which is super important to me. There is no eye irritation either. I think I found the sunscreen I'm going to stick with.
As someone who worries about sun damage, having a sunscreen that works well AND doesn't leave a white sheen on my skin makes all the difference. It works extremely well, especially for everyday use.

I usually fear the breakouts when I wear sunscreen. NOT ANYMORE! My skin literally looks SO good after wearing this that it actually makes me want to wear it every day. Took it to Maui with a UVI of 11 and it kept me protected!

I bought this under the impression that it was the same formula as original from Olive Young. Needless to say, it is not even comparable; the white cast is awful, it blends in splotchy, my makeup doesnt sit right, the list goes on. Hoping to save another loyal Round Lab user, skip this one.
You can never go wrong with round lab sunscreen. Say no more white cast and sticky sunscreen! I ABSOLUTELY RECOMMEND!!!!!
I got this because i loved the 45+ SPF and thought the extra coverage would be but the different formula left my skin feeling dry and the whitecast was unmistakable.

I absolutely love the birch line so I was wondering about what the SPFs in this line would be like! Upon first application it is silky and got myself blends in seamlessly. I love the tone-up of this SPF as it helps negate my redness and doesn't sting or burn my eyes! All and all I adore this SPF! It isn't drying at all for my skin (sensitive) but I also apply moisturizer before using this sunscreen. I would definitely recommend!
since the e-commerce experience is not more clear that this is not the korean formula, they should offer free returns.
Terrible, leaves a white cast, dries out skin. Do not buy it from This websites.
The sunscreen feels good on the skin and protected me from any sunburn during a very sunny beach vacation.

I tried the original formula awhile ago and decided to buy more and to try this version. Its more mattiying which i like. Goes on very smooth. The white cast made me panic at first but it goes away very quickly so you dont have to work it into your skin longer compared to other white cast sunscreens. Would recommend this and the original!
It's not good for me because it leaves white spots on my face

avis.titre: not as good as the original!
avis.texte: I love the original Birch sunscreen but wanted to try this one because it was made for mild skin. It didn't go on as smoothly and it leaves a terrible white cast that you really have the rub in.

avis.titre: Feels Thick and Leaves a White-ish Film
avis.texte: Love the regular sunscreen, but don't think I would use this one again. It's a solid product when you compare with other company's sunscreens; however, not the best when it comes to round lab's portfolio of products.
The white cast doesn't blend super well, and creates noticeable streaks

I was excited to buy this because I was researching all over the place for a mild sunscreen, after having tried a TON already-from Blue Lizard, La Roche-Posay, among many others. Eventhough they were supposed to be for sensitive skin, my eyes AND skin would give me a burning sensation-that is what led me here. Upon applying the Round Lab, it seemed to go on nicely, there was no scent, which was fine, BUT, I did notice a *very* subtle white cast on my face, which I was very disappointed about. As the day went on, I noticed a little bit of tingling-could've been from the herbal ingredients-but, I mainly just could not live with the white cast. It's not worth me returning. I don't recommend it.
I like this if I'm wearing makeup because it does have a white cast.
Haven't used it yet but so far all products are great. No reactions.

I've broken it down to what I desire in a sunscreen: moisturizing, protection, and appearance. Moisturizing: 4/5. My skin does feel moisturized temporarily after putting it on. But I usually have to layer a little moisturizer after to make my face feel less dry. Protection: 5/5. One of the ingredients used is zinc oxide. It can dry skin out, but is great for protection from the UV rays. Appearance: 4/5. It leaves a white cast for me. It also has a mattifying effect. My face look a little ashy but oddly airbrushed. Average score: 4/5. I would get it again for the hot summer months when I need moisturizers with mattifying effects. But it is autumn and soon winter on the east coast and I need something moisturizing and protective without making me look ashen.
This works well and I don't mind the white cast that this leaves. The white cast disappears after about 5min of letting it absorb. This works well under makeup and does not mess with the placement.
Love this sunscreen. Smooth application and doesn't feel sticky
This product did not work for me at all. It was crazy thick and left a white cast. It was difficult to wash off and didn't mix well with moisturizer.
